description: Coded government / municipal PROCEDURE registry entry — one record per procedure × jurisdiction × authority, holding the procedure's 窓口 / 所管 (省庁・自治体) / オンライン申請URL / 必要書類 / 様式 / 手数料 / 法定処理期間 / 根拠法令 / channel so a toritsugi cell can guide + (eventually) file procedurally (ADR-2605312030 §2). OPEN DATA (derived from the authority's own published guidance; provenance mandatory). CONSTITUTIONAL: `verificationStatus` gates live submission (G14) — `toritsugi_submit` MUST refuse any entry that is `unverified-seed` or whose `lastVerified` is outside the freshness window. Seed entries enable guide/routing design only; live filing requires `maintainer-verified` (public procedure) or `council-verified` (代行 / R3 path, which additionally requires 行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+ per G15). Never fabricate procedure data (G8): `legalBasis` + `provenance` are mandatory.

title.description: Procedure display name (e.g. '住民票の写し交付請求')

regime.description: Procedure regime / level (jurisdiction × tier of government). knownValues are illustrative, not exhaustive — worldwide seed coverage spans JP/US/EU/DE/FR/UK/CA/AU/IN/SG/BR/MX/KR + Council of Europe.

authority.description: 所管 — the ministry / municipality / agency responsible (窓口)

onlineUrl.description: Online application portal URL if any (per-自治体 may resolve at guide time)

formRef.description: chigiri procedure-template id used to guide/compose this procedure

feeJpy.description: 手数料 in JPY if any (best-effort; varies by 自治体). Reports the official statutory fee charged by the AUTHORITY — toritsugi itself never charges any fee/consideration (G9). 0 = no charge; absent/null = fee varies or not yet coded.

feeUsd.description: Official authority fee in USD if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeEur.description: Official authority fee in EUR if any (best-effort; varies by Member State / insurer). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeGbp.description: Official authority fee in GBP if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeCad.description: Official authority fee in CAD if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeInr.description: Official authority fee in INR if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeSgd.description: Official authority fee in SGD if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeBrl.description: Official authority fee in BRL if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeMxn.description: Official authority fee in MXN if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

feeKrw.description: Official authority fee in KRW if any (best-effort; varies). Not a toritsugi charge (G9). 0 = free; absent/null = varies or not yet coded.

statutoryProcessingDays.description: 法定処理期間 / target processing days (status_track basis; 0 = same-day/immediate)

legalBasis.description: 根拠法令 — MANDATORY (G8 non-fabrication), e.g. '住民基本台帳法 §12'

provenance.description: Source URL this entry was derived from (the authority's published guidance) — MANDATORY (G8)

lastVerified.description: When the procedure data was last human-verified

verificationStatus.description: G14 submission gate. `unverified-seed` => guide-design only, NO live submission. `maintainer-verified` => member self-submission guidance allowed. `council-verified` => 代行 (R3) path eligible (still gated by G15 + 行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+).

confidence.description: Maintainer's best-effort confidence in this seed entry's accuracy. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — independent of the constitutional G14 gate: any entry (regardless of confidence) is guide-design-only until verificationStatus advances past unverified-seed.
